title: Leviticus Bible Quiz - Chapter 21
description: Ten questions on Leviticus 21: rules of holiness for the priests and the high priest, and for descendants of Aaron with a defect.

questions.text: For which relative may an ordinary priest defile himself when that person dies?
questions.explanation: A priest could defile himself for close relatives: his mother, father, son, daughter, brother, and his virgin sister who has had no husband.

answers.text: His virgin sister who has had no husband
His wife's father who lives with him
His uncle on his father's side
His cousin from his mother's family

questions.text: Which of these does verse 5 forbid the priests to do?
questions.explanation: The priests were not to shave their heads, shave off the corners of their beards or make cuttings in their flesh.

answers.text: Wear linen garments in the sanctuary
Eat the bread of their God
Shave off the corners of their beards
Wash their hands and feet with water

questions.text: What does verse 6 call the offerings of Yahweh made by fire?
questions.explanation: The priests were to be holy because they offer the offerings of Yahweh made by fire, the bread of their God.

questions.text: Which woman does verse 7 forbid a priest to marry?
questions.explanation: A priest was not to marry a prostitute or a profane woman, nor a woman divorced from her husband, because he is holy to his God.

answers.text: A woman whose father has died
A woman divorced from her husband

questions.text: Whom does a priest's daughter profane if she plays the prostitute?
questions.explanation: Verse 9 says a priest's daughter who profanes herself by playing the prostitute profanes her father, and she shall be burned with fire.

questions.text: What must the high priest not do with his clothes?
questions.explanation: The high priest, on whose head the anointing oil is poured, must not let his hair hang loose or tear his clothes.

questions.text: Which relatives does verse 11 name, saying the high priest must not defile himself even for them?
questions.explanation: The high priest must not go in to any dead body, or defile himself for his father or for his mother.

questions.text: Whom was the high priest to take as his wife?
questions.explanation: He was not to marry a widow, a divorced woman, a defiled woman or a prostitute, but a virgin of his own people.

answers.text: A widow of his own tribe
The daughter of any Levite who was divorced
A virgin of his own people

questions.text: Which of these is listed as a defect that kept a descendant of Aaron from offering the bread of his God?
questions.explanation: Among the defects listed are blindness, lameness, a flat nose, any deformity, an injured foot or hand, and more.

questions.text: What may a descendant of Aaron with a defect still do?
questions.explanation: Although he may not come near to offer, he shall eat the bread of his God, both of the most holy and of the holy.

answers.text: Eat the bread of his God
Offer the offerings made by fire
Serve at the altar on the Sabbath
